messages.content: I'm working on a note-taking app. I'd rather keep the UI minimal. The app must support Markdown. What's the best way to sync notes between devices?

You could use CRDTs. See [Automerge](https://automerge.org/) and https://crdt.tech for background.

```js
const doc = Automerge.init();
```
Let's use Automerge. Please implement a sync prototype. Avoid any paid services.
